name: Freezing Floor

stealth.details: (expert) or DC 31 Perception check (master) to notice the cold fog rising from the floor

disable: DC 24 Thievery check (expert) to erase a rune, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24) to dispel a rune; all three runes must be erased or dispelled to disable the trap.
reset: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.
routine: (3 actions) With each action, the trap attempts a frost jet Strike against any creature standing on the white bricks. The trap loses 1 action per disabled or dispelled rune.

items.name: Cold Snap
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on the white bricks

---

Effect The trap makes a frost jet Strike against the triggering creature and rolls initiative.

items.name: Frostbite
items.text:
A creature that takes persistent cold damage from the trap's frost jet Strike must attempt a DC 18 Fortitude save save.

---
Critical Success The creature isn't affected and is immune to this frostbite effect for 24 hours.

Success The creature isn't affected.

Failure The creature can't stop shivering and becomes Clumsy 1.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature becomes Fatigued.

text: The white brick floor radiates ice-cold air.
